rows.business_description: Marc Norman is the founder of the consulting firm “Ideas and Action” and Associate Dean of NYU's Schack Institute of Real Estate. Norman has worked in the field of community development and finance for over 25 years. With degrees in Political Economics (U.C. Berkeley, B.A. 1989) and Urban Planning (UCLA, M.A. 1992) he has worked collaboratively to develop or finance over 2,000 units totaling more than $400 million in total development costs. Having worked for for-profit and non-profit organizations, consulting firms and investment banks he currently consults with architects, planners, non-profit organizations and others throughout the United States and the world. Through Ideas and Action Norman is currently partnered with non-profit housing developers, throughout the U.S.  For the State of New York, Norman led a team in Elmira, NY as part of the Empire State Poverty Reduction Initiative. This innovative initiative gathered a range of stakeholders, aggregated various data sources and collaborated with families in living in poverty to tackle systemic issues related to housing, employment and wrap around services. Ideas and Action has participated in every round of  New York State's Downtown Revitalization Initiative for cities throughout the state. Other projects include economic development analysis and anti-gentrification measures on behalf of cities and Community Development Financial Institutions. In addition to the work of the consulting firm Norman conducts research and writes on issues of housing and economic development. Publications include, “Projecting Rust Belt Futures: Underwriting Icicles and Leveraging Sidewalks” which outlined strategies for bringing investment in neighborhoods where values do not support traditional lending methods. In addition to publications and research Norman created “Designing Affordability” an exhibition of best practices in policy, finance and architecture encompassing projects from around the world. The exhibition has run in the U.S., Australia and is currently running in the 2017 Bi-City Biennale of Urbanism/Architecture  in Shenzhen, China.  Marc Norman serves on multiple boards of non profit organizations and serves as chair for the Federal Reserve's Community Advisory Council.

MindFrame Talent Development Solutions: A Systematic Blueprint for Excellence
?
MindFrame Talent Development Solutions is a premier organizational development consultancy designed for agencies that lead on the front lines of social change. We understand that in the social justice and service sectors, your mission is only as strong as the systems supporting your people. We do not just offer human resources advice; we architect the structural integrity required to turn high-level vision into community impact.
?
The Value Proposition: Strengthening the Heart of Your Mission

?For a mission-driven organization, "good enough" is a risk to those you serve. MindFrame specializes in moving agencies from functional to exceptional. We apply the MindFrame Method—a proprietary approach that treats talent development with the same technical rigor as a multi-million dollar capital project.
?Our goal is to build a self-sustaining ecosystem where leadership is clear, processes are lean, and every staff member is a strategic partner in your mission. We provide the quiet confidence that your internal systems are robust enough to withstand the external pressures of social service work. We don't just solve immediate staffing gaps; we build the infrastructure that prevents them from recurring.
?The Systematic Solution: The Vision-to-Value (V2V) System
?
The greatest challenge in social justice today is finding and keeping talent that reflects the communities we serve. Our proprietary Vision-to-Value (V2V) system solves this systematically.
?
V2V is a professional pipeline designed to identify and cultivate non-traditional talent—individuals with lived experience and diverse backgrounds—and transition them into high-impact business partners. We translate non-linear professional paths into the technical and leadership skills your agency needs. This ensures your workforce remains authentic to your mission while operating at the highest level of professional excellence.
?
The MindFrame Methodology: How We Transform Your System
?
MindFrame operates at the intersection of human behavior and operational discipline. Our work focuses on three pillars:

?1. Strategic Governance & Leadership
We align your human capital with your long-term goals. This includes designing scalable organizational structures, strengthening board-level oversight, and ensuring your leadership team is prepared for both growth and crisis.

?2. Agile Project Management
Social service environments are volatile. We bring Agile and PMP methodologies to your talent lifecycle, creating a "Ready-Response" culture. This allows your teams to pivot quickly without burning out or losing sight of their objectives.

?3. Operational Excellence (Lean Six Sigma)
We use Lean Six Sigma to audit your internal workflows. By removing administrative waste from recruitment and performance management, we free your staff to focus on what matters most: service delivery and social impact.

?Credentials Anchored in Purpose
?The MindFrame Method is led by a principal with a dual background in Psychology and Economics. This ensures every strategy is grounded in an understanding of human motivation and fiscal responsibility. Our expertise is backed by the industry's highest standards:

?Strategic Leadership: SPHR, GPHR, SHRM-SCP (The gold standards for HR strategy).

?Precision Execution: PMP and PMI-ACP (Expertise in project delivery and flexible planning).

?Process Rigor: Lean Six Sigma and Quality Management (QMA/OE).

?Mission-Critical Ethics: CASAC-Advanced (Deep expertise in behavioral health and ethical decision-making).

?The Outcome: A Resilient, Future-Proof Agency
?Partnership with MindFrame results in a fundamental shift in your organizational DNA:
?Total Mission Alignment: Your internal culture becomes a mirror of your external values.
?Sustainable Pipelining: A permanent end to talent shortages through the V2V model.
?Operational Clarity: Streamlined processes that reduce burnout and increase impact.
?
MindFrame Talent Development Solutions provides the sophisticated frameworks necessary to build a resilient, inclusive, and high-performing agency that can meet the challenges of the next decade with confidence.

rows.business_description:
R K Software, Inc. is a New York City–based (Long Island City) software solutions company founded in 1999, certified by New York City and New York State as a Minority-owned Business Enterprise (MBE) and Disadvantaged Business Enterprise (DBE), providing information technology services to government agencies and public-sector organizations. Over more than 25 years in business, we have delivered secure, compliant software solutions for city, state, federal, and private-sector clients, including NYC Parks, the NYC Department for the Aging, the New York Police Pension Fund (NYPPF), Battery Park City Authority (BPCA), NIGC, Bank of India, Bank of Baroda, and NYC Department of Social Services (DSS), among others. We also hold a New York State OGS Procurement of Backoffice, IT & Support Staffing (PBITS) contract and a federal GSA Multiple Award Schedule (MAS) contract, reflecting a track record across multiple layers of government procurement.

In short, RKSI builds, modernizes, and supports software systems, databases, websites, and payment platforms for government agencies, using Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid project methodologies depending on each agency's preferred delivery approach. The additional detail below outlines our specific technical capabilities across each service area, to help agencies locate the exact expertise they need.

We design, build, implement, modernize, customize, and support secure software systems, enterprise applications, databases, web platforms, and payment processing solutions. Our services include custom software development, application development, systems integration, software engineering, and full lifecycle software solutions. We provide programming and development in support of new system builds, legacy system modernization, system enhancements, refactoring, re-platforming, technical upgrades, cloud computing, and API development. We specialize in designing and implementing scalable, secure, and user-friendly applications that improve internal operations and public-facing services.

R K Software delivers database design, database development, database architecture, data modeling, data conversion, and data migration services. We perform legacy data migration, data transformation, ETL (extract, transform, load), system consolidation, data validation, data reconciliation, and data integrity management. We work with relational databases, SQL-based systems, cloud-hosted databases, and enterprise data environments.

We provide website design, website redesign, website modernization, web portal development, content management systems (CMS), and digital platform implementation. Our services include front-end development, back-end development, responsive web design, accessibility compliance (WCAG), user interface (UI) and user experience (UX) improvements, and secure hosting environments. We develop custom web applications, intranet portals, extranet systems, and public-facing information platforms.

Our team delivers business analysis, requirements gathering, systems analysis, functional specifications, technical documentation, workflow design, process improvement, and project management services using both Agile and Waterfall methodologies, tailored to each agency's preferred development lifecycle. We support agencies in translating business needs into technical solutions through structured analysis, stakeholder engagement, and solution architecture design.

R K Software provides payment processing system development and integration, including Automated Clearing House (ACH) payment systems, credit card payment processing, merchant services integration, and electronic payment gateways. We implement secure transaction processing, payment reconciliation systems, financial reporting tools, and compliance monitoring. Our expertise includes anti-money laundering (AML) controls, fraud mitigation, transaction auditing, PCI-compliant systems, and financial systems integration.

We support software configuration, customization, mitigation of system risks, security hardening, performance optimization, and cloud migration initiatives. We provide quality assurance (QA), software testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), defect tracking, and system validation services. Our senior technical team includes experienced software developers, systems architects, database specialists, business analysts, and technical project managers.

RKSI supports government modernization initiatives, digital transformation efforts, enterprise system upgrades, and targeted system improvements. Our expertise spans application development, database systems, website and portal solutions, financial and payment systems, data migration, system integration, and ongoing technical support. We partner with agencies to deliver secure, compliant, scalable, and efficient technology solutions that enhance service delivery, improve operational efficiency, and support mission-critical objectives.

rows.business_description:
At Renew'd For Life we practice a holistic approach to health and wellness, which means that we look at how all areas of the person's life are connected. Does stress on job or in your relationship(s) cause overeating? Does lack of sleep or low energy prevent you from exercising? As we work together, we will look at how all parts of connected life affect health as a whole.
We work with clients to get in touch with their body's needs because we understand that life happens, and needs will change. We want to equip people with the self-awareness to make the best decisions in any given circumstance. We believe each person is fully capable of making well-informed decisions as their own expert, not the latest magazine article or fad diet book.
We use assessment tools to assist the client to define what they value most. We'll use these visions to motivate specific goals that bring them closer to where they want to be. As a health and wellness coach, we will not dictate a diet, but together we will explore why some foods make you feel better than others and how to strategically use that feedback. Together we¿ll co-create your health goals within reasonable time frames and actionable objectives, so you know exactly what you're working toward.
Clients seek Renew¿d services for several reasons:
Statistics show: Chronic conditions like obesity, hypertension, and diabetes are present in our population at unacceptably high and costly levels. More than 78 million American adults are obese, and more than 1 in 20 is extremely obese. About 70 million U.S. adults have hypertension with only 52 percent having the condition under control. Just over 29 million Americans have diabetes and an additional 86 million have prediabetes. The medical costs of these conditions are staggering ¿ an estimated yearly total of $147 billion for obesity, $42 billion for hypertension, and $245 billion for diabetes. 

One of the successful and under-utilized remedies for this these conditions is behavior change in the form of dietary and/or activity modifications. Behavior change is hard, however Renew¿d makes behavior change easier health and wellness coaching. We teach, coach, support, follow-up and maintain.

Our experts are not just consultants; they are partners in your journey toward digital transformation.

Why Choose Sharpe Operations?

Contact Us

rows.business_description:
Tech Valley Talent is a certified woman-owned business (WBE) and Information Technology (IT) Professional Services firm. Our services and consulting expertise extends across the IT enterprise, and focuses on Digital Transformation, Data Management, IV&V, Infrastructure Services and Project Support Services (PMO/PM, Quality Assurance, Business Analysis, Organizational Change Management) as well as staffing services on a contract or perm-placement basis. Tech Valley Talent is a prime government vendor with an emphasis on the Energy, Health and Human Services, Financial and Insurance verticals.  Established in 2008, we have over 12 years of experience and are founded on the values of high integrity, trust, honesty, and commitment.  Our team provides exceptional value to our clients by supplying and delivering the best IT project-based and hourly talent across the nation.  We use the best-of-breed recruitment processes and practices coupled with a custom and data-centric approach to our clients and marketplace, resulting in talent optimization.  Our partnerships with key manufacturing firms enable us to provide even greater value to our clients seeking solutions and services.

Core Competencies
IT Staff Augmentation
Project Support Services
Independent Verification & Validation (IV&V)
Digital Transformation
Data Management
Infrastructure Services 

IT Staffing
Staff Augmentation: We help you reach your business objectives by supplementing your staff with the best IT personnel to meet your needs at just the right time! We offer both contract and contract-to-hire staff augmentation services. Permanent Placement - We take great pride in being able to find you exactly the right technical talent for a job that goes beyond the life cycle of a single project. We are proud members of SHRM, ASA and SIA.

Project Support Services
TVT excels in managing projects as well as providing the right technologies and technologists to do the job.  Our project management expertise is based on industry standard best practices and methodologies and involves oversight as well as IV&V and technical project management. We are also well versed in helping clients to develop PMOs, managing and implementing them. As part of this area of expertise, we also embrace and utilize best practices around Organizational Change Management (OCM). We are proud members of PMI and IEEE.

Independent Verification & Validation (IV&V)
The primary focus of Independent Verification and Validation (IV&V) is to work with the client to ensure that the products developed, and processes employed by a project meet specified requirements, adheres to industry & state standards, employs best practices and is being managed and controlled accordingly to the approved and baselined project plans. We ensure the project stays HEALTHY.

Digital Transformation
We provide a full spectrum of web and mobile design and development services for private clients and public agencies, including intranets, database development, systems-to-web integrations, UI/UX architectures, and design, graphic, mobile, and content services. From consultation through development, to final phase testing, our Tech Valley Talent web team ensures that your online goals are met.

Data Management
Managing one’s data to make better business decisions is critical to any organization’s success in today’s world. We offer our clients technology agnostic assessments, architectural reviews, design services, implementation expertise, conversion work, and integration & migration. We only work with Best of Breed solution providers including IBM, Tableau, Microsoft, SAS and Oracle.

Infrastructure Services
Our goal is to help you more cost-effectively meet the ever-changing demands of IT innovation without compromising security. We provide MS SharePoint, Cloud, MS365, expertise, solution specialists, and time-tested methodologies that meet all your IT Security and Cloud-based architecture and transformation to Cloud needs. We assess, manage and help clients mitigate risk across each aspect of your business.
